precautions: Keep the person away from the wet area.
Clean the spill and dry the floor.
Place a warning sign until the floor is dry.
Keep children and other vulnerable people away from the drain.
Install a secure, load-appropriate cover or barrier.
Report the uncovered drain to the responsible authority.
Keep everyone away from the exposed wire.
Do not touch the wire or nearby wet surfaces.
Arrange for a qualified electrician to isolate and repair it.
Keep the stairs clear of objects.
Use a secure handrail when available.
Provide appropriate supervision for people with mobility difficulties.
Keep people away from the broken glass.
Use appropriate protective equipment to collect the fragments safely.
Dispose of the fragments in a suitable, puncture-resistant container.
Keep the walking path clear of trailing cables.
Arrange cables along walls or secure them with suitable cable covers.
Avoid damaged cables and overloaded extension boards.
source: Project prototype guideline: cable and electrical safety

precautions: Remove loose items, bags, and footwear from walking paths.
Keep frequently used walkways clear.
Provide extra assistance to people with balance or mobility difficulties.
source: Project prototype guideline: indoor trip prevention

precautions: Check whether the rug slips or curls at the edges.
Use a suitable non-slip backing or secure the rug.
Remove the rug if it cannot be secured safely.
source: Project prototype guideline: rug and floor safety

precautions: Move heavy items from high storage positions to a stable, lower location.
Keep frequently used items within easy reach.
Avoid standing beneath unstable or overloaded storage.
